Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.model.players

Class HumanPlayer

java.lang.Object
com.example._0zo.model.players.Player
com.example._0zo.model.players.HumanPlayer
public class HumanPlayer extends Player
Represents a human-controlled player in the Cincuentazo game.

Card selection for a human player is driven entirely by the UI: the player clicks a card, which is submitted to the TurnManager via submitHumanCard(). Therefore selectCard(int) always throws InvalidMoveException; it should never be called directly for human turns.
